_note: Physical behaviour only. Visual appearance lives in presentation code. Initial values are tuning starting points, to be calibrated in play (Batch 5). Units: density = mass per square pixel; health = damage points; resistances = fraction of damage absorbed (0-0.95); min_damage = per-hit damage (after resistance) below which a hit is ignored; structural_resistance (optional, defaults to impact_resistance) = fraction of structural damage (falls, crushing, debris) absorbed; blast_transmission = share of a blast (damage and knockback) that passes through a component of this material when it stands between the blast and a target (0.05-1, multiplied per blocker; weapon penetration lets part of the blocked share through).

materials._note: The AI core's shock-mounted housing: as soft as other electronics to weapon fire, but built to survive falls and debris, so a collapse exposes and damages it rather than destroying it outright.
